title: Save on Smartwatches, Smart Rings, and Wearables Before Prime Day Ends
gist: Wired's Prime Day wearables roundup: Apple Watch Series 12 at $350, Fitbit Charge 6 at $90, Pixel Watch 5 at $335, Galaxy Watch8 at $209 and other smartwatch discounts, with prior-generation models offering the best value.

insights.claim: Apple Watch Series 12 was discounted to $350 from $399 on Amazon, the lowest price the reviewer has seen, and surprisingly early for the latest model.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Early discounting of Apple's newest watch hints at channel promotion; watch for Black Friday parity.
insights.locator: The Newest Apple Watch Is Already Discounted

insights.claim: Google's Pixel Watch 5, released this past summer, was on sale at $335 (16% off) and is the second Pixel Watch designed to be repairable.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Repairability design is spreading in wearables.
insights.locator: The Latest Google Pixel Watch Is $65 Off

insights.claim: Fitbit Charge 6 fell 44% to $90 and Inspire 3 to $70, positioning Fitbit as a cheap on-ramp to health tracking.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Deep Fitbit discounts show it is a low-end entry product within Google's wearables line.
insights.locator: Google Fitbits Are Almost Half Off

insights.claim: Garmin Epix Pro (Gen 2) was $470 off at $530 and Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra $172 off at $478, indicating large markdowns on premium wearables.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Premium wearable clearance suggests inventory clearing ahead of new launches.

insights.claim: The reviewer argues previous-generation watches (Apple Watch SE 3 at $199, Galaxy Watch8 at $209, Watch7 at $159) are better value unless the newest health metrics are required.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Weak incremental features per generation depress upgrade pull and price of new models.
insights.quote: Unless you absolutely need the intricate health tracking, save your money
insights.locator: Save Up to $221 on a Samsung Galaxy Watch

insights.claim: Apple did not update the Apple Watch SE this year, so the SE 3 lacks newer features such as Audio Intelligence.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Apple's skipped SE refresh keeps its low-end product on an older cycle.
insights.locator: Save on the Best Value Apple Watch

insights.claim: Nothing's CMF Watch 3 Pro was $59 (25% off) with dual-band GPS, a voice assistant and a mic, showing how much function now reaches the sub-$60 tier.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Feature-rich ultra-cheap smartwatches pressure mid-range makers.
